video_title: Serena Winters: Welcomes Peyton Watson to Cleveland

quotes.speaker: Peyton Watson
quotes.summary_phrase: Peyton Watson on the importance of resilience in his career
quotes.excerpt: resilience. I think that's the name of the game in life.
quotes.quote: I would say just the resilience. I think that's the name of the game in life. There's going to be a lot of adversity that hits at different points in time. It could hit early, late, or anywhere in between, and you have to be ready to get back up and keep swinging. That's something that I've really prided myself on throughout my life, and I think that it's made me who I am today.

quotes.speaker: Peyton Watson
quotes.summary_phrase: Peyton Watson on his identity as a lifelong learner
quotes.excerpt: more so than anything, I'm a lifelong learner. I'm somebody who's very inquisitive.
quotes.quote: More so than anything, I'm a lifelong learner. I'm somebody who's very inquisitive. I'm somebody who likes to be educated about a lot of stuff and knowledgeable about a lot of things. And things that I don't know about, I'm always trying to search for answers and more information about. So, I'm just somebody who really loves the life that I've been able to make for myself. Super blessed, super grounded, and I'm looking forward to learning as much as I can.

quotes.speaker: Peyton Watson
quotes.summary_phrase: Peyton Watson on the authenticity of the Cavaliers organization
quotes.excerpt: how authentic and genuine the energy is with the team.
quotes.quote: My impression of the Cavs was definitely, first and foremost, how authentic and genuine the energy is with the team. Just talking to the coaches, talking to people in the front office, and various members of our staff, everybody has been super welcoming, super warm, and they've really shown that their approach to this is they're here for the players and they're here for the betterment of us and the team.

quotes.speaker: Peyton Watson
quotes.summary_phrase: Peyton Watson on the importance of learning his new teammates
quotes.excerpt: it was super important for me to learn a lot about my teammates on and off the court.
quotes.quote: It was super important for me to learn a lot about my teammates on and off the court. We've been spending time, we bonded in New York, we had a mini camp together where I learned a little bit more about the guys that were there. And then also just being here in Cleveland a little bit earlier ahead of season is giving me the time to get to know these guys a little bit better, and I think that'll help with our chemistry on the court as well.

quotes.speaker: Peyton Watson
quotes.summary_phrase: Peyton Watson on Donovan Mitchell's leadership and welcoming nature
quotes.excerpt: he took the initiative to get to know me, to make me feel included.
quotes.quote: Since it's been announced that I was going to be a Cleveland Cavalier, he took the initiative to get to know me, to make me feel included, to invite me to pretty much everything he's done for the better part of this last month or so of offseason. And it just shows the type of guy that he is, and I think that's something that I was really drawn to because I love to do that stuff. I love to get to know people, I love to know who I'm playing with, and he's just made it super easy bridging that gap.

quotes.speaker: Peyton Watson
quotes.summary_phrase: Peyton Watson on his long-standing connection with Evan Mobley
quotes.excerpt: I've been knowing Evan for the better part of my basketball life and career.
quotes.quote: I've been knowing Evan for the better part of my basketball life and career. I remember playing against him in Pangos camps growing up. I remember just seeing him on the AAU circuit. He played for Compton Magic. I'm from Long Beach, Compton is literally in that neck of the woods. So, I think that I've always kind of known of him and we've been in the same circles basketball-wise. We played against each other in high school, and we had some battles in high school, but I think that we both have a lot of respect for one another's games.

quotes.speaker: Peyton Watson
quotes.summary_phrase: Peyton Watson on his transition to living in Cleveland
quotes.excerpt: I love how lush and green it is everywhere.
quotes.quote: I love how lush and green it is everywhere. Being able to see trees and open space and the layout of the city is something that's super refreshing to me. And I see Cleveland as a place where I'm going to build up a lot of relationships because everybody here is so authentic and genuine. But also I see it as a place where I'm building a home out here. I'm really looking forward to embracing my time here, just like the team has embraced me, just like the city has embraced me.
